title: Feedback wanted for a 3D fps/rts roguelite!
author: OrganizationLow5701
selftext:
Ive been using makeplay.ai, browser based game creation platform,  ive been adding content and was wondering what people thought thus far!

Here u can try it out on pc

https://makeplay.ai/p/a77nstybpq

comments.author: Sabatoshi
comments.body: Tell me you don't need to pay for that service... This is terrible.

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: Its free haha, im honestly playing around with it, it might not look great, but its quite easy to implement ideas fairly quickly.

replies.author: Sabatoshi
replies.body: It's not creating anything that couldn't be created without it easily.

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: Well its easily accessible and useable for someone like me who has no experience with coding, all on a browser, im trying to make something that i'll find fun playing eventually.

comments.author: theflossboss1
comments.body: Is this supposed to be a game?

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: Its very basic right now, what stands out the most that u do not like

replies.author: account009988
replies.body: Boring to play. Everything feels weak. Uninspired visuals. Too much to mention tbh it just sucks I dont ever want to play that again

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, i want to work on the visuals more soon, this is very basic right now.

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: If visuals are next, I’d test hierarchy before polish: can players instantly distinguish their units, threats, interactables, and objectives in both FPS and RTS views? If that read fails, extra detail may only make the screen noisier. I’m building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) for focused playtesting of AI-built games; this hybrid would benefit from separate test questions for each camera mode.

comments.author: Beginning_Yam_8637
comments.body:
It’s pretty wild honestly. Prototyping games is incredibly convenient, and if you look closely, you’ll find plenty of high-quality creations?

https://preview.redd.it/b2npj9hebfdh1.png?width=2290&format=png&auto=webp&s=2a0336affb88faa4ff116ac990ab124da1ca9dce

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: On that platform? Yea, im rly surprised how some games look/play so well.

comments.author: Beginning_Yam_8637
comments.body: Bro, I think the drone enemies need to stand out more. They’re kind of blending into the background.
